```{r create-functions, include=FALSE}

load_results_list <- function(path, format) {
  if (format == "rds") {
    return(readRDS(path))
  } else if (format == "RData") {
    env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    load(path, envir = env)
    if (exists("results_list", envir = env)) {
      return(env$results_list)
    } else {
      stop("No 'results_list' object found in RData file.")
    }
  } else {
    stop(paste("Unknown file format:", format))
  }
}

calc_posterior_prob_positive <- function(model, pars = NULL, flip = FALSE) {
  
  draws <- as_draws_df(model)
  
  if(is.null(pars)){
    pars <- names(draws)
    pars <- pars[grepl("^b_", pars)]
    pars <- pars[!grepl("Intercept", pars)]
    pars <- pars[!pars %in% c("lprior", "lp__")]
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Parameter = character(),
    Mean = character(),
    Lower_CI = character(),
    Upper_CI = character(),
    P_Positive = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for(par in pars){
    if(par %in% names(draws)){
      par_draws <- draws[[par]]
      
      # Flip the outcome direction if requested (equivalent to refitting with 1 - Y)
      if (flip) {
        par_draws <- -par_draws
      }
      
      par_mean <- mean(par_draws)
      par_ci <- quantile(par_draws, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
      prob_positive <- mean(par_draws > 0)
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        Parameter  = par,
        Mean       = sprintf("%.3f", par_mean),
        Lower_CI   = sprintf("%.3f", par_ci[1]),
        Upper_CI   = sprintf("%.3f", par_ci[2]),
        P_Positive = sprintf("%.3f", prob_positive),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

needs_outcome_flip <- function(model_name) {
  grepl("^NSDUH.*Global Health", model_name)
}

hdi_95 <- function(x, ci = 0.95) {
  x <- sort(x)
  n <- length(x)
  window_size <- ceiling(ci * n)
  widths <- x[(window_size + 1):n] - x[1:(n - window_size)]
  best <- which.min(widths)
  c(lower = x[best], upper = x[best + window_size])
}

summarize_posterior <- function(x) {
  hdi_vals <- hdi_95(x)
  c(est = mean(x), lo = unname(hdi_vals["lower"]), hi = unname(hdi_vals["upper"]))
}

get_wave_labels <- function(model_name) {
  if (grepl("^NCHA", model_name)) {
    return(c(first = "Fall 2008", last = "Spring 2019"))
  } else {
    return(c(first = "First Wave", last = "Last Wave"))
  }
}

print_coding_info <- function(model_obj, flip = FALSE) {
  data <- model_obj$data
  formula_obj <- formula(model_obj)
  
  outcome_var <- all.vars(formula_obj$formula[[2]])
  if (flip) {
    cat(sprintf("**Outcome:** `%s` — in the underlying NSDUH data this variable is coded in the **opposite** direction from the ACHA/NCHA global-health outcome, so the raw model summary above predicts the unwanted category. **For consistency with the ACHA/NCHA convention (1 = the category of interest, 0 = the other), the derived tables below (Posterior Probability of Positive Direction and Derived Effect Summary) have been sign-flipped.** This is mathematically equivalent to refitting the model with `1 - %s` as the outcome.\n\n",
                outcome_var, outcome_var))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("**Outcome:** `%s` — coded **1 = yes / presence**, **0 = no / absence**\n\n",
                outcome_var))
  }
  
  all_pred_vars <- all.vars(formula_obj$formula[[3]])
  exclude_vars <- c("school_id", "c_Time", "quad_c_Time", "c_year", "quad_c_year",
                     "c_time", "quad_c_time")
  pred_vars <- setdiff(all_pred_vars, exclude_vars)
  
  if (length(pred_vars) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  for (v in pred_vars) {
    if (!v %in% names(data)) next
    col <- data[[v]]
    
    if (is.factor(col)) {
      levs <- levels(col)
      cat(sprintf("**%s:** Reference = `%s`; Other levels: %s\n\n",
                  v, levs[1],
                  paste(sprintf("`%s`", levs[-1]), collapse = ", ")))
    } else if (is.character(col)) {
      levs <- sort(unique(col))
      cat(sprintf("**%s:** Levels (alphabetical, first = reference): %s\n\n",
                  v, paste(sprintf("`%s`", levs), collapse = ", ")))
    } else if (is.numeric(col)) {
      uvals <- sort(unique(col))
      if (length(uvals) <= 5 && all(uvals == round(uvals))) {
        cat(sprintf("**%s:** Coded values = {%s}; reference (in interactions) = 0\n\n",
                    v, paste(uvals, collapse = ", ")))
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("**%s:** Continuous (mean = %.2f, range = [%.2f, %.2f]); set to 0 for derived estimates\n\n",
                    v, mean(col, na.rm = TRUE),
                    min(col, na.rm = TRUE), max(col, na.rm = TRUE)))
      }
    }
  }
}

calc_effect_summary <- function(model_obj, model_name, flip = FALSE) {
  
  draws_df <- as_draws_df(model_obj)
  data     <- model_obj$data
  n_draws  <- nrow(draws_df)
  
  time_var <- NULL
  for (v in c("c_Time", "c_year", "c_time", "c_Year")) {
    if (paste0("b_", v) %in% names(draws_df)) {
      time_var <- v; break
    }
  }
  if (is.null(time_var)) {
    message("  [calc_effect_summary] Could not detect time variable for: ", model_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  quad_var <- NULL
  for (v in c("quad_c_Time", "quad_c_year", "quad_c_time", "quad_c_Year")) {
    if (paste0("b_", v) %in% names(draws_df)) {
      quad_var <- v; break
    }
  }
  
  t_first <- min(data[[time_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  t_last  <- max(data[[time_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (!is.null(quad_var) && quad_var %in% names(data)) {
    q_first <- data[[quad_var]][ which.min(abs(data[[time_var]] - t_first)) ]
    q_last  <- data[[quad_var]][ which.min(abs(data[[time_var]] - t_last))  ]
  } else {
    q_first <- 0
    q_last  <- 0
  }
  
  b_int  <- draws_df[["b_Intercept"]]
  b_time <- draws_df[[paste0("b_", time_var)]]
  b_quad <- if (!is.null(quad_var)) draws_df[[paste0("b_", quad_var)]] else rep(0, n_draws)
  
  safe_draws <- function(name) {
    if (name %in% names(draws_df)) return(draws_df[[name]])
    rep(0, n_draws)
  }
  
  fe_names <- rownames(fixef(model_obj))
  int_fes  <- fe_names[grepl(":", fe_names)]

  time_names <- c(time_var)
  if (!is.null(quad_var)) time_names <- c(time_names, quad_var)


  X <- tryCatch(
    stats::model.matrix(brms::brmsterms(formula(model_obj))$dpars$mu$fe, data = data),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  covariate_offset <- rep(0, n_draws)
  if (!is.null(X)) {
    xbar <- colMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE)

    exclude <- c("Intercept", paste0(time_names))
    for (cn in names(xbar)) {
      if (cn %in% exclude) next
      if (grepl(":", cn)) next            
      bcol <- paste0("b_", cn)
      if (bcol %in% names(draws_df)) {
        covariate_offset <- covariate_offset + draws_df[[bcol]] * xbar[[cn]]
      }
    }
  }

  groups <- list()

  if (length(int_fes) == 0) {
    groups[["Overall"]] <- list(
      logit_first = b_int + covariate_offset + b_time * t_first + b_quad * q_first,
      logit_last  = b_int + covariate_offset + b_time * t_last  + b_quad * q_last
    )
  } else {
    mod_coefs <- c()
    for (fe in int_fes) {
      parts    <- strsplit(fe, ":")[[1]]
      non_time <- parts[!parts %in% time_names]
      mod_coefs <- c(mod_coefs, non_time)
    }
    mod_coefs <- unique(mod_coefs)

    if (!is.null(X)) {
      for (mc in mod_coefs) {
        bcol <- paste0("b_", mc)
        if (mc %in% names(xbar) && bcol %in% names(draws_df)) {
          covariate_offset <- covariate_offset - draws_df[[bcol]] * xbar[[mc]]
        }
      }
    }

    groups[["Reference"]] <- list(
      logit_first = b_int + covariate_offset + b_time * t_first + b_quad * q_first,
      logit_last  = b_int + covariate_offset + b_time * t_last  + b_quad * q_last
    )

    for (mc in mod_coefs) {
      b_mod  <- safe_draws(paste0("b_", mc))

      b_t_int <- safe_draws(paste0("b_", time_var, ":", mc))
      if (all(b_t_int == 0)) b_t_int <- safe_draws(paste0("b_", mc, ":", time_var))

      b_q_int <- rep(0, n_draws)
      if (!is.null(quad_var)) {
        b_q_int <- safe_draws(paste0("b_", quad_var, ":", mc))
        if (all(b_q_int == 0)) b_q_int <- safe_draws(paste0("b_", mc, ":", quad_var))
      }

      groups[[mc]] <- list(
        logit_first = b_int + covariate_offset + b_mod + (b_time + b_t_int) * t_first + (b_quad + b_q_int) * q_first,
        logit_last  = b_int + covariate_offset + b_mod + (b_time + b_t_int) * t_last  + (b_quad + b_q_int) * q_last
      )
    }
  }
  

  if (flip) {
    for (gn in names(groups)) {
      groups[[gn]]$logit_first <- -groups[[gn]]$logit_first
      groups[[gn]]$logit_last  <- -groups[[gn]]$logit_last
    }
  }
  
  wave_labels <- get_wave_labels(model_name)
  
  results <- data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  for (grp_name in names(groups)) {
    grp     <- groups[[grp_name]]
    p_first <- plogis(grp$logit_first)
    p_last  <- plogis(grp$logit_last)
    
    or_draws  <- (p_last / (1 - p_last)) / (p_first / (1 - p_first))
    rr_draws  <- p_last / p_first
    ard_draws <- (p_last - p_first) * 100
    pf_draws  <- p_first * 100
    pl_draws  <- p_last * 100
    
    or_s  <- summarize_posterior(or_draws)
    rr_s  <- summarize_posterior(rr_draws)
    ard_s <- summarize_posterior(ard_draws)
    pf_s  <- summarize_posterior(pf_draws)
    pl_s  <- summarize_posterior(pl_draws)
    
    fmt2 <- function(s) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", s["est"], s["lo"], s["hi"])
    fmt2_sign <- function(s) sprintf("%+.2f [%+.2f, %+.2f]", s["est"], s["lo"], s["hi"])
    
    row <- data.frame(
      Group                = grp_name,
      OR                   = fmt2(or_s),
      RR                   = fmt2(rr_s),
      ARD_pp               = fmt2_sign(ard_s),
      stringsAsFactors     = FALSE
    )
    # Dynamic column names for wave labels
    row[[paste0("Pct_", wave_labels["first"])]] <- fmt2(pf_s)
    row[[paste0("Pct_", wave_labels["last"])]]  <- fmt2(pl_s)
    
    results <- rbind(results, row)
  }
  
  return(results)
}

format_table <- function(df, caption = NULL){
  df %>%
    kable(caption = caption, digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
}

format_diagnostics <- function(diagnostics) {
  if (is.null(diagnostics)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(diagnostics$extraction_error)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Diagnostic = "Extraction Error",
      Value = diagnostics$extraction_error,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  diag_df <- data.frame(
    Diagnostic = c(
      "Divergent Transitions",
      "Max Rhat",
      "N Parameters with Rhat > 1.01",
      "Min ESS Ratio",
      "N Parameters with ESS Ratio < 0.1"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(diagnostics$n_divergent %||% "NA"),
      as.character(round(diagnostics$max_rhat %||% NA, 4)),
      as.character(diagnostics$n_high_rhat %||% "NA"),
      as.character(round(diagnostics$min_ess_ratio %||% NA, 4)),
      as.character(diagnostics$n_low_ess %||% "NA")
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(diag_df)
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

```{r iterate-models, results='asis', fig.keep='all'}
model_counter <- 0

for(i in seq_along(models_to_report)){
  model_entry <- models_to_report[[i]]
  model_name <- model_entry$name
  model_path <- model_entry$path
  model_format <- model_entry$format
  
  cat(sprintf("\n# %s\n\n", model_name))
  
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n**File not found:** `%s`\n\n", model_path))
    cat("\n---\n\n")
    next
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    results_list <- load_results_list(model_path, model_format)
    
    if(!isTRUE(results_list$model_success)){
      cat("**Model fitting was not successful.**\n\n")
      if(!is.null(results_list$error_message)){
        cat(sprintf("**Error message:** %s\n\n", results_list$error_message))
      }
      if(!is.null(results_list$error_traceback)){
        cat("```\n")
        cat(paste(results_list$error_traceback, collapse = "\n"))
        cat("\n```\n\n")
      }
      cat("\n---\n\n")
      next
    }
    
    model_obj <- results_list$brms_fit
    
    if(is.null(model_obj) || !inherits(model_obj, "brmsfit")){
      cat("\n**Error:** Could not extract brmsfit object from results_list.\n\n")
      cat("\n---\n\n")
      next
    }
    
    cat("\n## Model Information\n\n")
    if(!is.null(results_list$model_name)){
      cat(sprintf("**Model Name:** %s\n\n", results_list$model_name))
    }
    cat(sprintf("**File Format:** %s\n\n", toupper(model_format)))
    if(!is.null(results_list$run_time)){
      cat(sprintf("**Computation Time:** %.2f hours\n\n", as.numeric(results_list$run_time)))
    }
    
    cat("\n## Model Formula\n\n")
    cat("```\n")
    print(formula(model_obj))
    cat("```\n\n")
    
    model_counter <- model_counter + 1
    

    flip_outcome <- needs_outcome_flip(model_name)
    
    cat("\n## Contrast Coding & Reference Groups\n\n")
    tryCatch({
      print_coding_info(model_obj, flip = flip_outcome)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("*Could not extract coding info: %s*\n\n", e$message))
    })
    
    cat("\n## Prior Specifications\n\n")
    
    priors_df <- NULL
    if (!is.null(results_list$brms_priors)) {
      priors_df <- as.data.frame(results_list$brms_priors)
    } else {
      priors_df <- tryCatch(
        as.data.frame(prior_summary(model_obj)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
    }
    
    if(!is.null(priors_df) && nrow(priors_df) > 0){
      print(format_table(priors_df, caption = "Prior distributions used in the model"))
    } else {
      cat("All priors used default settings.\n")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("\n## MCMC Diagnostics\n\n")
    
    if (!is.null(results_list$diagnostics)) {
      diag_df <- format_diagnostics(results_list$diagnostics)
      if (!is.null(diag_df)) {
        print(format_table(diag_df, caption = "Sampling diagnostics summary"))
      }
    } else {
      cat("No pre-computed diagnostics available. See trace plots and model summary for convergence assessment.\n")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("\n## Model Summary\n\n")
    cat("```\n")
    print(summary(model_obj), digits = 3)   
    cat("```\n\n")
    
    cat("\n## Trace Plots\n\n")
    cat("Trace plots show the MCMC chains across iterations. Good mixing appears as a 'hairy caterpillar' pattern.\n\n")
    
    pars_to_plot <- variables(model_obj)
    pars_to_plot <- pars_to_plot[grepl("^b_|^sd_|^cor_", pars_to_plot)]
    
    if(length(pars_to_plot) > 0){
      par_groups <- split(pars_to_plot, ceiling(seq_along(pars_to_plot)/6))
      
      for(j in seq_along(par_groups)){
        p <- mcmc_trace(model_obj, pars = par_groups[[j]])
        print(p)
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("No parameters to plot.\n\n")
    }
    
    cat("\n## Posterior Predictive Checks\n\n")
    cat("Posterior predictive checks compare the observed data (dark line) to simulated data from the model (light lines).\n\n")
    
    pp <- pp_check(model_obj, ndraws = 20)
    print(pp)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("\n## Posterior Probability of Positive Direction\n\n")
    cat("This table shows the posterior mean, 95% credible interval, and the probability that each effect is positive (> 0).\n\n")

    prob_dir <- calc_posterior_prob_positive(model_obj, flip = flip_outcome)
    
    if(nrow(prob_dir) > 0){
      print(format_table(prob_dir, caption = "Posterior probability of positive direction for each parameter"))
    } else {
      cat("No parameters to analyze (only intercept in model).\n")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("\n## Derived Effect Summary (First + Last Wave)\n\n")
    cat("Odds ratio, risk ratio, point estimates (%), and absolute risk difference (pp) comparing the last wave to the first wave. ")
    cat("Covariates held at their sample means (dummy covariates at their sample proportions), i.e. the average covariate profile. Random effects set to 0 (population-average). ")
    cat("Intervals are 95% HDI.\n\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      effect_tbl <- calc_effect_summary(model_obj, model_name, flip = flip_outcome)
      if (!is.null(effect_tbl) && nrow(effect_tbl) > 0) {
        print(format_table(effect_tbl, caption = "Derived contrasts: last wave vs. first wave"))
      } else {
        cat("*Could not compute derived contrasts (time variable not detected).*\n\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("*Error computing derived contrasts: %s*\n\n", e$message))
    })
    cat("\n\n")
    
    rm(results_list, model_obj)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    
    cat("\n---\n\n")
    
  }, error = function(e){
    cat(sprintf("\n**Error loading or processing model:** %s\n\n", e$message))
    cat("\n---\n\n")
  })
}

cat(sprintf("\n# Summary\n\n**Total models successfully processed: %d / %d**\n\n",
            model_counter, length(models_to_report)))
